name: authenticate
description: Open a visible Chrome browser window to perform manual SSO/MFA login. Optionally navigates directly to the specified target URL and saves authenticated session cookies once complete.

url.description: Optional target enterprise URL to navigate to for login (e.g. 'https://jira.company.com').

timeout_seconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds to wait for user login. Defaults to 900 (15 minutes).
